meta.title: A Note from May
meta.textType: a note from family or a friend

paragraphs: Dear Lily. How are you? I am writing this note at home, because I have a small cold. Pat will give it to you at school. Please read it today, because it has important information for tomorrow.

The bus leaves the school gate at eight o'clock. Do you know which gate? It is the small gate near the library, not the big gate near the road. That is half an hour earlier than usual, because the park is far. Ranger Mark will meet us at the entrance. The trip finishes at noon. Teacher Kim will count all the children before the bus leaves. Teacher Kim needs the permission forms today. Please write your first name and your surname on the form. Teacher Kim puts a gold star on each form that a parent has signed. Please ask your mom to sign yours tonight.

Teacher Kim says, "Everybody needs some equipment." Bring a bottle of water, a hat, a notebook, and old shoes. The path is not hard, but it can be wet. The walk is about three kilometers, so your shoes must be strong. Mia will bring the camera, and Leo will bring his cartoon book. I will bring a bag of fruit for all of us.

Now some news from my house. My grandma has a guest this weekend, and the house is very busy. The guest brought me a golden sun hat from the market. I will wear it tomorrow, so you can find me easily. Bill, our parrot, says "Hello, Lily!" all day. I think he learned your name from Pat. Pat thinks that Bill is very noisy, but I love him. Do you want to meet him after the trip?

The park itself is open from eight o'clock to five o'clock, and the trail is easy. I hope that we will see many birds. Mia has a new bird book, and she will share it. If it rains, we will take the covered path. Please do not forget the form. I am sure that it will be a lovely day. See you tomorrow at the gate. Your friend, May.
text.summary: May writes a note to Lily the day before the club trip to the nature park. She gives the time, the things to bring, and some news about her family.
